map.垃圾产生量计算器：在线输入参数即可即时得到结果，无需安装与注册。: Waste generation calculator: enter parameters online to get results instantly, no installation or registration needed.
map.月垃圾量 = 基础量 + 食品残渣 + 包装 + 一次性用品 + 衣物；人均每日: Monthly waste = base + food scraps + packaging + disposables + clothing; per-capita daily = (monthly × 12 / people) / 365
map.基础量 = 人数 × 1.2 kg/人/天 × (1 + 地区修正)（城区 0、: Base = people × 1.2 kg/person/day × (1 + region adjustment) (urban 0, suburban −0.1, rural −0.2); food scraps = people × (cooking factor + leftovers factor) × 30 (cooking: cook every meal 2.5 / often 1.5 / occasionally 0.8 / almost never 0.3; leftovers: none 0 / occasional 0.3 / frequent 0.7, in kg/person/day); packaging = takeaway count×4×0.4 + parcel count×4×0.15 kg; disposables = people × factor × 30 (low 0.5 / medium 1.0 / high 2.0); clothing = none 0 / small amount 5 / large amount 15 kg. Judging is by per-capita daily: <0.5 extremely low, <1.0 low, <1.5 near average, otherwise high.
map.家庭自查：按人口与生活习惯估算月度垃圾量，并与人均 1–1.2 kg/天对照。: Household self-check: estimate monthly waste from population and lifestyle, then compare against the 1–1.2 kg/person/day benchmark.
map.减量规划：对比减少外卖、合并快递后包装垃圾的下降幅度。: Reduction planning: compare the drop in packaging waste after cutting takeout and consolidating parcels.
map.社区宣传：用不同参数演示一次性餐具与衣物消费对垃圾量的影响。: Community outreach: use different parameters to show how disposable tableware and clothing consumption affect waste volume.
map.人均多少算正常？: What per-capita amount counts as normal?
map.中国人均生活垃圾约 1–1.2 kg/天。低于 1.0 显示环保良好，1.0–1: China's per-capita municipal solid waste is about 1–1.2 kg/day. Below 1.0 indicates good environmental practice, 1.0–1.5 is near the national average, and above 1.5 suggests reduction is needed.
map.哪几项对结果影响最大？: Which factors affect the result most?
map.按系数看，一次性餐具高档为 2.0 kg/人/天、餐餐做饭为 2.5 kg/人/: By factor, a high disposable-tableware setting is 2.0 kg/person/day and cooking every meal is 2.5 kg/person/day, so these two dominate the total; takeout and parcels accumulate linearly with frequency, so cutting frequency works fast.
